Values are cataloged as printed for each exact style prefix. The price book cautions that its general guidance may not apply to all prefixes and refers readers to the Product Information Guide for prefix-specific detail.

product_guide_measurements.note: Values are copied from the guide's Dimensions table for the exact style numbers. Linear measurements are inches; WT_LB is product/unit weight, not user-weight capacity. Blank source cells remain null.
